scope: What a reality is and which kinds of reality are declared: an open kind list in the owner's control order, presentations of those kinds, and classification kept separate from containment.
exclusions: No kind is treated as more real than another; the control order is a prerequisite of reaching a layer, not a degree of reality.
No kind name is aliased to another; 'reality' is not silently 'base-reality'.
Whether a sempiternity contains base-reality or a base-reality contains a sempiternity is not decided.
Observability belongs to Hyperspace and order to Hypertime; neither is defined here.
No physical, cosmological, or simulation claim is established.
The owner's control order (2026-10-05) is encoded as CONTROL_ORDER; whether oreality is around or within hypergeometric reality, and the direction of the inherits/supports arrows, are open.
No counterpart relation is expressed; the registry has only is-a and is-in.
No physical, anchoring, or bubble claim is established; the cat-map toy checks a finite computation only.
